newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET - Canty win toss, bat in Shell Cup final.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET - Canty win toss, bat in Shell Cup final.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Jan 15 - Canterbury captain Lee Germon won the toss and elected to bat first in the limited-overs Shell Cup final cricket match at the Basin Reserve on Wednesday.
Both teams have named the same lineups as yesterday, when the match was rained off after only 15 overs were completed.
Wellington: Roger Twose (captain), Phil Chandler, Scott Weenink, Jason Wells, Richard Petrie, Robbie Kerr, Gavin Larsen, Paul Jarvis, Chris Nevin, Mark Jefferson, Glenn Jonas.
Canterbury: Lee Germon (captain), Darrin Murray, Nathan Astle, Craig McMillan, Stephen Fleming, Chris Cairns, Chris Harris, Mark Priest, Glenn Muir, Geoff Allott, Warren Wisneski.
